references.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual reference for an original browser racing game, to be manually redrawn in SVG. Draw one small original sporty racing car seen perfectly from directly overhead, front facing straight UP, all four wheels visible, a compact rounded body with recognisable windshield, pale cream racing stripe, dark charcoal outlines and simple limited flat cel shading. Colour palette coral #ef8f75, warm cream #fff0d3, charcoal #302b27; sophisticated playful print illustration, not childish, not photoreal or 3D. Transparent background, generous clearance on all sides, no cast ground shadow, no text, no number, no brand or logo. Car symmetrical enough for sprite rotation; bold clear silhouette at 40 pixels.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: art reference for an original browser game cover, will be manually redrawn as SVG. A dynamic but friendly two-person stick-figure arena duel, one coral and one lilac, wearing simple oversized boxing gloves, bold rounded charcoal stick limbs and expressive action poses: one jumps forward while the other leans back ready to counter. Clear friendly round heads with no face, no gore, no injury. Grounded on a warm cream arena mat with a single graphic yellow action star between gloves. Background muted pale lilac with one oversized soft cream circle, two tiny dust clouds. Sophisticated editorial vector-like line illustration, clean bold shapes, slightly offbeat and tactile, no photorealism, no 3D, no text, no numbers, no UI, no brands. Wide landscape composition readable as a small game card. Palette coral #ef8f75 lilac #baa0d9 charcoal #302b27 warm cream #fff0d3 yellow #f4d765.
